ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 55:45 ratio of low-intensity (dark) to high-intensity (white) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity (white) contiguous patches occupy the lateral thirds of both lobes, while the medial third is dominated by a low-intensity (dark) vertical band. The left lobe's white patch contains roughly five parallel dark vertical streaks.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped depression with a measured pixel angle of approximately 112 degrees and a bounding-box depth equivalent to 14% of the visible vertical fluke span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel-amplitudes ranging from 4 to 12 pixels. The left lobe trailing edge displays significantly higher peak-to-valley variance compared to the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Outer margins of both lobes follow a convex parabolic curve originating from the peduncle and tapering to acute distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed clusters of circular high-contrast white pixels (3-8 pixel diameter) localized on the outer-left lateral margin and scattered across the trailing edge of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct dark linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) oriented vertically on the white patch of the left lobe; 2-3 shorter, unaligned linear marks visible on the white distal tip of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent irregular protrusions on the left lateral edge created by high-contrast white calcareous organism colonization (barnacles).
